name: dsh-peak-status
description: Peak-hour indicator for the DSH web GUI: a native header chip showing whether the current Beijing time is inside DeepSeek's API peak window (weekdays 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00; weekends all-day valley price), with a live clock, countdown, and ×2/off-peak pricing hints. Statutory holidays and 调休上班的周末 are valley all day — only ordinary weekdays can peak; the official work calendar is fetched over the network and cached. Economy mode adds a per-chat switch that holds a chat’s model calls and freezes its goal for the duration of a peak window, resuming them automatically in the half-price valley, with a green-leaf dormant indicator while a call is parked. · DSH Web GUI 高峰指示灯：原生会话头部胶囊，实时显示当前北京时间是否处于 DeepSeek API 高峰时段（工作日 9:00-12:00 / 14:00-18:00，周末全天谷价；法定节假日与调休上班的周末均全天谷价、只有普通工作日才有高峰，节假日表联网获取并缓存）。
